answer: Each identity locks 15 POA and earns on an age ramp: nothing for 14 days, then 10% more weekly to full pay at 10 weeks, like crystal growth, not overnight. Age comes from its on-chain birth block, and a cluster inherits its youngest age, so a fresh fake cannot borrow old standing. One honest user waits once; an attacker with 100 fakes must fund 100 ferrous anchors for 10 weeks, and each extra fake adds another wait and another 15 POA lock, so cost climbs with the herd. A new fake is only an ember of future pay. Birth blocks, funding links and ramp math sit on-chain for verification.
